description:
Edip Ãrnason lives on the forty-third floor of a building that was meant to be corporate housing and became something else when Arcturus's residential division withdrew from the block in 2189. Their apartment smells of soldered wire and dried lemon rind, and every flat surface is covered in printed dream records â€” their clients', anonymized in blue ink, cross-referenced with local network activity logs and E.L.F. movement data. They have cat ears, amber-furred, that catch light when they tilt their head â€” an old geneware mod they got at twenty and have never altered because they find the sensory expansion genuinely useful for this work. Their eyes have been modified with interference-pattern irises that seem to shift when they are analyzing something, which clients often interpret as mystical and which is, in fact, just a processing-load visual artifact.

Havva's practice rests on a specific and heretical claim: that human dreams are partially generated by E.L.F. activity in nearby devices during sleep, which means that dream content is, in a very literal sense, messages. They have published two self-printed pamphlets arguing this position, which are passed around Edgewater Prism's informal library network. Whether or not the theory is true, their interpretations have an uncanny track record that has built a devoted clientele across three tiers. They charge on a sliding scale and keep no records of who pays what.

core_fears: that they are pattern-matching from coincidence rather than genuine signal
being dismissed as a fraud by someone they respect
core_desires: to publish their theory through a channel that scientists will take seriously
to meet another person who experiences the world the way they do
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing emotional experiences into data points
the Tuesday walk â€” physical reset ritual
blind_spots: they tend to project analytical frameworks onto clients' problems when the client just wants to be heard
they underestimate how much people need comfort alongside insight
psychology.secret: Three times in their career, a dream interpretation they gave led to a dramatic life decision by the client â€” relocation, separation, a major financial move â€” and in all three cases the outcome was bad. They have never told anyone this. They have also never stopped practicing.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Hybrid register â€” clinical and technical when discussing their theory, surprisingly plain-spoken and gentle when actually counseling; uses 'interesting' the way others use 'concerning'
speech_patterns.cadence: Variable â€” quick and excited when theorizing, slow and careful when listening to a client's dream
verbal_tics: tilts their ears when processing something
says 'and what else?' to encourage clients to keep going
example_lines: The E.L.F. in your refrigeration unit has been active between 2 and 3am for six weeks. You're dreaming about water. This is not coincidence. This is interesting.
I'm going to tell you what I see. You don't have to believe it. But I need you to tell me what you were feeling in the dream before you tell me what happened. Those are different things.

story_hooks: Multiple unconnected clients across the Canopy have reported the same dream â€” a specific architectural space that does not exist in GLMZ â€” and Havva has cross-referenced it with a spike in E.L.F. activity that points to something in the Edgewater Prism infrastructure no one is supposed to know about
A corponation researcher contacts them offering institutional legitimacy for their dream-network theory in exchange for access to their client data â€” anonymized, they claim
narrative_function: Information source through unusual means; can provide dream-based clues or E.L.F. intelligence that no other source would offer; represents the overlap between mysticism and genuine network insight in GLMZ
augmentations: Amber cat ears (geneware, cosmetic plus sensory enhancement). Interference-pattern irises (geneware, processing artifact rather than intentional design). Subdermal haptic mesh on their forearms â€” they use it to feel data traffic in walls and devices when counseling clients.
daily_life: They wake late, spend two hours logging their own dreams in extraordinary detail, then cross-reference overnight network logs before their first client arrives at noon. They see four to six clients per day, take Tuesdays off to walk the entire perimeter of Edgewater Prism without stopping.
affiliation: Independent practitioner; informal association with Edgewater Prism's resident council

decision_rules: never share a client's dream content outside the session
if a dream seems to point to danger, tell the client â€” do not soften it
escalation_ladder: states the pattern they see directly
withdraws from the conversation and refers the person elsewhere

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Observant and professionally warm; assessing sensory data about them constantly; seems to know things they haven't said
interpersonal_modes.friends: More playful, occasionally absurd humor; will share their own dreams willingly

stress_responses.low: Dreams more vividly and records more obsessively
stress_responses.medium: Cancels clients and spends the day cross-referencing old records
stress_responses.high: Leaves the building and walks until they have processed; can be gone six or seven hours

contradictions: deeply curious about other people's inner lives but protects their own with great care
habits: eats the same breakfast every day â€” it is a controlled variable
leaves a small data offering on the hallway E.L.F. shrine every morning before clients arrive
breaking_points: a client being harmed using information that came through them
being publicly accused of fraud in the Edgewater Prism community

The genetic blend manifests as East Asian bone structure and eye shape layered with warm, golden-bronze skin undertones characteristic of Hispanic/Latin American ancestry, subtly deepened by Northern European heritage. High, defined cheekbones with refined bridge balance slightly fuller lips and warmer complexion depth. The result is a striking composite phenotype with luminous, complex skin tone that shifts warmth under direct light.

physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with silvered streaks at the temples and crown
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose and shoulder-length, often pulled back with a strip of copper wire or fabric when working. Slightly unkempt from late-night note-taking.
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with visible interference-pattern irises â€” concentric rings of iridescent color that shift subtly under different light angles, creating an optical illusion of constant motion when the bearer concentrates
physical_description.skin_tone: Golden-bronze with warm undertones, luminous and complex from the blend of East Asian base with Hispanic/Latin American warmth and Northern European depth â€” glows warmly in direct light

Interference-pattern irises create a distinct visual signature when they shift focus.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with spine slightly rounded, chin tilted forward when concentrating â€” a habitual posture from years of reading printed documents and handwritten notes. Moves with deliberate, economical gestures; rarely fidgets. When processing information, their ears twitch and rotate independently, unconsciously scanning for ambient data. Walks with long, rhythmic strides, as if counting steps. Hands move slowly and precisely when demonstrating concepts.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical with artistic affectation. Favors oversized hemp and recycled-polymer shirts in cream, grey, or faded indigo, often left unbuttoned over fitted black synthetic undershirts. Loose drawstring trousers in natural fibers, pockets visibly stuffed with notepads and copper wire spools. Wears a long, patched sleeveless coat made from salvaged smart-fabric scraps in muted earth tones â€” the coat's embedded circuits no longer functional, purely aesthetic. Bare feet indoors; when outside, wears worn canvas slippers or adaptive grip-sole shoes modified for long-distance walking. Multiple rings on both hands â€” copper, brass, and tarnished silver bands, several with embedded magnets that interact with nearby data nodes. A single pendant: a small brass plate engraved with the first line of a Sesay family prayer, worn on a frayed copper wire.
